description: This file defines the MacNodeLocationService class, which manages location services using CoreLocation. It provides asynchronous methods for retrieving the current device location with support for timeouts, handles location updates, and errors. The class conforms to CLLocationManagerDelegate and includes custom error handling.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A final class that provides location updates and manages CLLocationManager with async support, including timeout handling and delegate methods for location updates and errors.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously requests the current location with specified accuracy, maximum age, and timeout parameters. Throws if location is unavailable or on timeout.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Wraps an async operation with a timeout implementation using DispatchWorkItem and continuation, handling both successful completion and errors.
